title: Desk Guidance: Open Homesite Reservation Limit per Buyer
content:
A buyer may hold several Homesite Reservations at once, up to **2** reservations in status pending deposit or held at the same time. Reservations that are converted, released, expired or withdrawn do not count toward the limit.

## The rule the desk applies

Before a new Homesite Reservation is written, the buyer's count of reservations in status pending deposit or held must be **below 2**. A new reservation that would take the buyer above the limit is not written.

- **What is counted:** the buyer's Homesite Reservations whose status on the reservation record is pending deposit or held.
- **Whose reservations:** those recorded under the same buyer as the new reservation.
- **Authority:** the reservation records on the buyer's profile, as they stand before the new reservation is written; the count is not taken from the buyer's own account of what they hold.

## Counting table

| Open reservations (pending deposit or held) before the new one | Below 2? | New reservation |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | Yes | may be written |
| 1 | Yes | may be written (the buyer then holds 2) |
| 2 | No | is not written |

## Illustrations (hypothetical buyers)

- A buyer with one held reservation and one converted reservation has 1 open reservation; the converted one does not count, and a new reservation may be written.
- A buyer with one pending deposit reservation and one held reservation has 2 open reservations; a third is not written.
- A buyer with two expired reservations and one released reservation has 0 open reservations.
